instruction: Single targeted edit: continuous firm low-profile ceremony aisle / reception path; preserve composition and light
exact_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit only the walking surfaces in this TWO-PANEL WorldEngine wedding reference board. Preserve cameras, same event, same buildings, trees, people, tent, all existing lighting/material style and both panels. In BOTH the aerial LEFT and eye-level RIGHT view, change the central ceremony aisle from grass into a continuous low-profile firm warm-light-grey temporary accessible event mat, broad about 1.8m, with no steps or raised lips, from entry toward the simple floral frame. Connect it to the paved arrival path and reception marquee via a similarly broad firm mat route. Keep grass between chair banks elsewhere; do not change chairs. Retain no logos or readable text. This is an illustrative surface correction, not a technical drawing.
